a.lede: Amazon Web Services logged attempts to leverage the internet-melting PHP2Shell bugs four days ago. They're now being “broadly exploited” across the internet.
a.title: Hackers Exploited the PHP Vulnerabilities Days Before They Were Patched

b.lede: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.
b.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
